eventDetail.scope: The 3rd International Conference on Smart Systems and Power Management (IC2SPM), organized by IEEE Joint Chapter IE/PE3/CAS/PE Lebanon, will be hosted Hybrid by the University of Saint-Joseph in Beirut, Lebanon. IC2SPM is an international forum for engineers, scientists, and researchers to present their state-of-the-art work in smart systems and power management. It also provides engineers with an opportunity to interact and share their experiences in industry and technology applications. The conference will run for two days. Submitted papers will be peer reviewed.
